source.dataset: GMBA Mountain Inventory v2 Standard Basic — regional mountain cores

properties.attribution: Derived from GMBA Mountain Inventory v2, Snethlage et al. (2022), GMBA-EarthEnv; clipped and coordinate-quantized by Alpine Loop. No endorsement implied.
properties.datasetCitation: Snethlage, M. A. et al. (2022). GMBA Mountain Inventory v2. GMBA-EarthEnv. https://doi.org/10.48601/earthenv-t9k2-1407
properties.paperCitation: Snethlage, M. A. et al. (2022). A hierarchical inventory of the world’s mountains for global comparative mountain science. Scientific Data 9, 149. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01256-y

derivation.method: Retain actual Standard Basic leaves selected for Washington, clipped to its pinned statewide scope and US limit. For California retain every Basic leaf intersecting the union of the four legacy effective footprints, clipped to that union. Preserve named leaves and exact ancestry IDs; no Broad polygons, EPA residuals or historical mountain-footprint enlargement.
derivation.repair: none; all selected source and clipped geometries valid
derivation.precisionMethod: GEOS set_precision valid_output; normalize; counterclockwise exterior rings and clockwise holes

limitations: Standard is a regional mountain inventory and can omit low foothills and worthwhile low-relief hiking landscapes. This does not assert trail-scale survey accuracy, source completeness, current access or route quality.
Geometries are clipped to this product’s Washington/California scope, not complete global ranges. Coordinate precision is not a positional-accuracy claim.
